label: geography: the country, the capital, and where you are from
note: grāmaḥ, nagaram and puram give village, city and walled town. THERE IS NO WORD FOR A COUNTRY (deśaḥ) AND NO PROPER PLACE NAME ANYWHERE IN THE TRACK, not even bhāratam. Counted covered on the settlement half; the country half is what makes SA-A1-SP-04 and SA-A1-ADJ-02 uncovered.
